title: Relief Answer Share and the Timeliness of the Employer's Response (Employer Benefit Charging)
content:
Employer Benefit Charging scales the relief credit of a determination on a separation response by how timely the response on record was.

**Rule.** The relief answer share is the whole when the response on record was received no later than the response window after the notice of claim mailing date or late with good cause shown; nine tenths when it was received after the response due date without good cause and no benefit charge was posted on the position after that due date; and three quarters otherwise, a response received after the due date without good cause when a payment was charged while the answer was overdue.

| Response on record | Charge posted after the due date | Relief answer share |
|---|---|---|
| Received on or before the response due date | — | 1.00 |
| Received after the due date, late with good cause shown | — | 1.00 |
| Received after the due date without good cause | None | 0.90 |
| Received after the due date without good cause | One or more | 0.75 |

**Records read.** The response date and the response due date recorded on the position (the due date is the last day of the response window counted from the notice of claim mailing date); the timeliness recorded for the response (late with good cause shown, or late without it); and the posting dates of the benefit charges on the position. A charge counts as posted after the due date only when its posting date is later than the due date.

**Late responses and the class term.** For a determination on a separation response the class term that payments issued before a late response stay charged even if relief is later granted is applied only through the relief answer share: a response received after the response due date without good cause takes the nine-tenths or three-quarters share, and no payment is kept charged on that account beyond it.

**Case notes (hypothetical; response due date 10 June).**

1. Response date 10 June. Not after the due date: 1.00.
2. Response date 16 June, recorded late with good cause shown; a charge posted 14 June: 1.00.
3. Response date 16 June, recorded late without good cause; latest charge posted 10 June: 0.90.
4. Response date 16 June, recorded late without good cause; a charge posted 14 June: 0.75.
